name: Time Travel Is No Picnic
storyline:
Tom is a teenage heavy metal fan who would much rather play his guitar than worry about the mysteries of science.

But when his father mysteriously disappears, Tom finds himself caught up in an extraordinary adventure involving an experimental time machine.

His search takes him through different periods of history, from the decks of the legendary Titanic to a mysterious tropical island.

Along the way, Tom encounters eccentric characters, faces unusual challenges, and uncovers clues about his father's disappearance.

Armed with curiosity, a healthy dose of sarcasm, and very little understanding of what he's gotten himself into, Tom must navigate the chaos of time travel to find his father.
summary:
Time Travel Is No Picnic is a humorous 2D point-and-click adventure about Tom, a young heavy metal fan searching for his missing father.

Travel through time, explore locations ranging from the Titanic to tropical islands, solve unusual puzzles, collect and combine items, and meet quirky characters along the way.

The game features classic point-and-click gameplay, dialogue-driven storytelling, hand-drawn comic-style visuals, and a mix of humor, mystery, and science fiction.
